desc:
🐾 Welcome to Raise Animals 🐾

Are you ready to build your very own animal farm? Catch animals from the play area, feed them, take care of them as they grow, and collect their produce! Show off rare animals and unique finds to your friends, and have fun raising your farm!

[🐓 How To Raise 🐄]
• Equip the animal you want to raise!
• Click on your farm to place them!
• Wait and watch your animals grow!
• Let tourists visit your zoo and give you money!

Remember, your animals keep growing and producing even while you’re offline⭐
